youtube.title: 2 Loan, ₹1 Lakh Extra: Pehle Kaun Sa Chukayein? #Shorts
youtube.description:
Do loan aur ₹1 lakh extra: pehle kaun sa chukayein? Avalanche method: sabse zyada interest wala loan pehle, baaki loans ki minimum EMI time pe.

Is video ke numbers:
• Credit card interest: kai issuers ~3.75% per month (≈45% per year); range issuer ke hisaab se alag (Paisabazaar, Credit Card Interest Rates in India 2026)
• Personal loan: 12% per year sirf example; asli rate bank aur profile ke hisaab se alag
• ₹1 lakh card pe = ~₹45,000 interest/saal bachega; personal loan pe = ~₹12,000; farak ~₹33,000/saal (simple calculation)

Aap kaun sa loan pehle chukate? 👇
